$comment: Commands, request and execution options, presentation flags and the value grammar. Method options are owned by spec/method-contract.json; the generator merges both into one option table and rejects name collisions.

grammar.tokens: docenhance [--help] [--json] | docenhance --version (no arguments renders help, exit 0) | docenhance COMMAND [OPERAND|OPTION]... . Only tokens beginning with '--' name options; '-', '-h' and '-input.png' are operands. OPTION is --NAME VALUE, --NAME=VALUE or a flag --NAME. A separated valued option always consumes the next token, including '--'; joined empty values stay empty and consume no later token. Flags given '=VALUE', unknown/repeated options, missing option values and extra operands are syntax errors. An unconsumed '--' ends options; later tokens are operands. Missing required operands and invalid option values belong to application admission, not tokenization. Only on syntax failure, an exact raw '--json' token before the first raw '--' selects JSON error rendering. Successful syntax uses parsed flag roles, including application refusals. Arguments must be well-formed UTF-8.
grammar.decimal: Finite decimal: optional leading '-', digits with an optional decimal point or a point followed by digits, and an optional exponent [eE][+-]?digits. No leading '+', whitespace, hexadecimal, infinity or NaN. Overflow, subnormal results and non-zero magnitudes rounded to zero are rejected; '.' in every locale.
grammar.integer: ASCII decimal digits only (leading zeros allowed); no sign, whitespace, fraction or exponent.
grammar.grid: Two integers joined by a lower-case 'x', for example 8x8.
grammar.path: Non-empty well-formed UTF-8 without NUL; never normalized or repaired.

process.summary: Process one PNG, JPEG or single-page TIFF/BigTIFF page and publish a new bundle directory.

verify.summary: Check that a bundle's artifacts agree with its run record without executing anything.

methods.summary: List the implemented methods and their parameter domains.

version.summary: Report the build, platform, compiler and dependency-lock identity.

options.name: --out-dir
options.summary: New result directory; its parent must exist and it is never replaced.

options.name: --output-mode
options.summary: Preserve keeps the decoded gray/color category, not source bytes, ICC space, metadata or alpha. Continuous output defaults to no enhancement filter and is verified before publication. Explicit stages follow geometry, illumination, denoising, restoration, contrast, sharpening and final quantization. Gray converts linear luminance; bw explicitly activates stored-sample binarization. JPEG and TIFF/BigTIFF support preserve/gray only; bw requires grayscale PNG.

options.name: --bit-depth
options.summary: Continuous output depth; auto keeps 16-bit source precision, otherwise 8.

options.name: --alpha
options.summary: Composite alpha over white or black in linear light, or reject any non-opaque pixel.

options.name: --profile-policy
options.summary: Interpret supported colour declarations, or override them with sRGB.

options.name: --rotate
options.summary: Exact clockwise quarter-turn; continuous input follows metadata orientation, bw rotates stored samples.

options.name: --protect-mask
options.summary: 1/8-bit grey PNG in metadata-oriented source dimensions; non-zero samples are never changed by photometric stages.

options.name: --json
options.summary: Render one JSON response on stdout and nothing on stderr.

options.name: --help
options.summary: Render help without opening input or creating output.

options.name: --version
options.summary: Human-readable alias of the version command.
